visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a spicy cabbage salad on a white plate with red chili slices and cilantro garnish. The plate rests on a yellow-white plaid cloth under bright studio lighting. (2) Hands wearing plastic gloves use a knife to cut light green baby bok choy into thin longitudinal strips on a wooden cutting board. (3) The cabbage strips are transferred to a clear glass bowl, where white salt is sprinkled over them and mixed by the gloved hands. (4) The hands squeeze a large bunch of cabbage over the bowl, causing clear liquid to drain out. (5) Fresh water is poured into the bowl and the cabbage is rinsed and squeezed dry once more. (6) Gloved hands use a spoon to add sugar, vinegar, dark oyster sauce, and chili oil from small glass containers into the bowl. (7) Minced garlic, chopped red chilies, and sesame seeds are added, and the ingredients are tossed together using chopsticks. (8) The final dish is presented on the plate again, decorated with a sprig of cilantro and red chili rings.
